title: This Frog Breaks Its Own Bones to Grow Claws. Here's How

scenes.text: This frog breaks its own bones to grow claws.
It's the hairy frog, from Africa.
When it's threatened, it contracts muscles and snaps the end bone of each back toe.
The broken bone swings down and pushes straight through the skin.
Scientists think it's a defense, and nothing quite like it has been seen before.
So those claws aren't made of keratin. They're the frog's own broken bones.
